layout1: Associations of OXPHOS and proliferation with BBC3 (PUMA), BCL2L1 (BCL-xL) and MCL1 expression in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Coefficients (SD per SD of each score) are from linear models of each gene on OXPHOS, MYC activity and intrinsic subtype, with tumour purity and leukocyte fraction in TCGA-BRCA; variables are rank-normalised within each cohort. OXPHOS was scored as subunit expression (level) or as its priority within the mitochondrial programme (priority). Open circles, OXPHOS without the proliferation term; filled circles, OXPHOS with it; triangles, proliferation. Left, Spearman correlation of OXPHOS with proliferation. Right, the proliferation coefficient minus the OXPHOS coefficient within the same model, with its 95% confidence interval from the model covariance. Bars, 95% confidence intervals.
layout2: As layout 1, with MYC activity added: squares, MYC activity without (open) and with (filled) the proliferation term. Second column, Spearman correlation of MYC activity with proliferation.
layout3: Top, the BCL-2 family as in layout 1, OXPHOS level only. Middle, pathological complete response in three neoadjuvant cohorts and their pooled estimate: odds ratios per within-cohort SD from logistic models, OXPHOS without (open) and with (filled) the proliferation term, and proliferation (triangles); right, the ratio of the two odds ratios within the same model. Bottom, breast-cancer-specific survival in ER-positive (IHC) METABRIC: hazard ratios from Cox models with proliferation; right, the ratio of hazard ratios. The BCL-2 family panel holds MYC activity fixed; the outcome panels come from models without a MYC activity term. The METABRIC correlation is over all 1,981 patients. Bars, 95% confidence intervals.
ed_a: Spearman correlations among the two OXPHOS scores, four MYC activity scores and proliferation in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143), shaded by band (below 0.60; 0.60 to 0.80; 0.80 or above). Each MYC activity score is labelled with the percentage of its genes in proliferation gene sets (Hallmark E2F targets and G2M checkpoint). Right, the reference MYC activity score against proliferation in three neoadjuvant cohorts.
ed_b: OXPHOS coefficients for BCL2L1 and BBC3 with MYC activity held fixed, without (open) and with (filled) the proliferation term, in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143), and the difference between them, with 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 paired bootstrap resamples of tumours. Bars on the coefficients, model-based 95% confidence intervals.
ed_c: MYC activity coefficients for BBC3, BCL2L1 and MCL1 on four MYC activity scores, ordered by the percentage of their genes in proliferation gene sets, without (open) and with (filled) the proliferation term, with the proliferation coefficient (triangles), in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Faded points are cells in which the score and proliferation correlate at 0.80 or more; they are shown and not interpreted. Bars, 95% confidence intervals.
ed_d: All twelve BCL-2 family genes: coefficients of OXPHOS (circles), proliferation (triangles) and MYC activity (squares), each with the other two held fixed, and the proliferation minus OXPHOS difference, on the reference MYC activity score (left) and the score with least overlap with proliferation gene sets (right), in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Bold, the three genes read under the declared rule. No correction for multiple genes. Bars, 95% confidence intervals.
s1: Sensitivity analyses in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938): OXPHOS and proliferation coefficients and their difference for BBC3, BCL2L1 and MCL1, as fitted, with TP53 mutation status added, and without tumour purity and leukocyte fraction (the SCAN-B covariate set), on the reference MYC activity score and the score with least overlap with proliferation gene sets. Bars, 95% confidence intervals.
